Mumbai Rain Injures Biker After Tree Branch Falls

A 50-year-old biker was injured in Mumbai's Andheri area when a tree branch fell on him during heavy rainfall. The incident occurred amidst severe weather conditions battering the city. This event highlights the potential dangers posed by falling branches during monsoon season in urban environments.
